Title: Qubole cross-account AWS role abuse - ipv4
Description: Attacker-controlled OVH server (AS16276, Germany) used from 15 to 26 October 2026 as the main address for assuming Qubole-trusted roles in customer AWS accounts, enumeration and credential harvesting. It also hosted sso_agent.iso, which beacons back to TCP 23458. May be reassigned after October 2026; review hits in that window. Source: Wiz – Trusted by Default: Qubole Cross-Account Access Abused in the Wild https://www.wiz.io/blog/qubole-cross-account-access-abused-in-the-wild
RecommendedActions: Block at the perimeter and search firewall, proxy, cloud and EDR logs back to October 2026 for connections.
